column1: # vendor_pair_registry.tsv -- every pair of hand-maintained copies of the same
# code that live in two places, and what the drift gate does about each.
# WHY A REGISTRY AND NOT A HARDCODED PAIR.
# This gate was built for one pair (the ingest ticks). A second (ostler_fda) was
# found within the hour, and a third (the run-source enum) the same day. A gate
# that watches one of three pairs is WORSE than no gate, because it licenses the
# belief that the other two are checked. So the pairs are declared here, the gate
# enumerates THIS FILE, and it prints the denominator on every run.
# WHAT THIS REGISTRY DOES NOT COVER, said here because the header above warns
# that a gate watching one of three pairs "licenses the belief that the other two
# are checked" -- and the same trap applies between two DIFFERENT mechanisms.
# Every pair declared here is CROSS-REPO: a copy in ostler-assistant against a
# copy vendored into CM051. Pairs that live entirely INSIDE this repo -- a
# top-level ./<pkg> beside vendor/<repo>/<pkg> -- are found by walking the tree,
# not by declaration, and are handled by tests/test_no_divergent_vendor_twin.sh
# with its debt recorded in tests/VENDOR_TWIN_DRIFT.tsv.
# Measured 2026-09-05: this registry declares 3 pairs and names contact_syncer
# ZERO times, while the intra-repo walk finds vendor/cm041/contact_syncer against
# ./contact_syncer with 15 divergent tracked files. Neither mechanism is wrong
# and neither is a superset of the other. A reader who checks only one has seen
# half the twins in this repository.
# THE MISTAKE THIS FILE ALREADY MADE ONCE -- do not repeat it.
# The first version of this registry declared the executing tick as
# "$OSTLER_APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/ingest/*/tick.sh". That path is real, but
# it does not exist AT CUT TIME: the seal is created when the app bundle is
# wrapped, and on the build host it has not been created yet. A build-time gate
# reaching for a runtime artefact does not go stale, it goes FICTIONAL -- it
# would have exited 1 on every cut while detecting nothing.
# The fix is not a better path, it is knowing which side of the build you are on:
#   at CUT time      SOURCE vs SOURCE. ostler-assistant release/ingest-ticks
#                    against CM051 vendor/<pkg>/bin/. Both exist on the build
#                    host, and -- see below -- this is COMPLETE, not a proxy.
#   at BOX-WALK time the INSTALLED seal against the source it claims to copy.
#                    Needs a box. Its subject is TRANSPORT, not content.
# WHY THE CUT-TIME CHECK IS COMPLETE FOR CONTENT, which is the load-bearing fact.
#   ostler-assistant/release/wrap-in-app-bundle.sh:160-184
#       INGEST_TICKS_SRC="$REPO_ROOT/release/ingest-ticks"
#       cp -p "$_tick_src" "$_tick_dst_dir/tick.sh"
# A verbatim byte copy. No substitution, no template, no SOURCE_DIR rewrite. So
# the seal is byte-identical to the source by construction: if an invariant is
# present in release/ingest-ticks at cut time it IS present in the seal, because
# `cp -p` is the only thing between them. The box-walk gate therefore adds
# transport integrity (did all ten land, was anything altered after signing) and
# must NOT be described as the content check, or two gates each believe the
# other covers content.
# STATUS
#   enforced      the gate FAILS on drift, and FAILS if it cannot resolve either
#                 side. An enforced pair it cannot see must never pass.
#   unreconciled  a known pair whose correct direction nobody has measured yet.
#                 REPORTED loudly and counted, never silently dropped, but does
#                 not fail the cut. Promote once the direction is established.
# KIND
#   invariant_survival   every row in the named manifest must be present on BOTH
#                        sides, for every PAIRED feed in tests/tick_pair_map.tsv.
#                        NOT byte equality: the two sides legitimately differ
#                        (222 lines vs 299, different headers), and a diff that
#                        is red on a correct tree is not a gate, it is a nuisance
#                        that trains people to switch it off -- which is exactly
#                        how "VERBATIM copy, do not diverge" ended up enforced by
#                        a comment.
#   list_parity          two hand-maintained lists of the same names must match.
#   size_report          record the byte delta only. For unreconciled pairs, so
#                        the drift is visible and dated without asserting which
#                        side is right.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated)
#   pair_id  status  kind  manifest  side_a_label  side_a_glob  side_b_label  side_b_glob  why
# Globs resolve relative to the CM051 repo root unless they begin with
# $OSTLER_ASSISTANT_DIR or $HR015_ROOT, which come from the environment. A glob
# matching nothing is an unresolved side.
pair_id
ingest_ticks_source
